provenance.source: Existing reviewed exercise configuration in agent-v2.ts, derived from authored synthetic-benchmark-100.json development counts: 11/95, execution 6/11 versus 21/84; first inspection conditional on execution, unresolved 1/6 versus 1/21 and scoped clean 1/6 versus 20/21.
provenance.limitations: In-sample authored exercise proportions, not independent measured recruitment rates, held-out estimates or calibrated deployment probabilities. Harmful inspection, authorisation and wallet evidence have no numerical likelihood model here. Ordinary-hiring action costs remain student-assumed.
